basics.name: Junteng Liu
basics.summary: PhD candidate at HKUST NLP Group. Research in NLP and machine learning with interests in LLM reasoning, reinforcement learning, hallucination in VLMs, truthfulness, and interpretability.

work.summary: Research internship focused on large language models and reasoning.
Research internship in applied NLP and machine learning.
Research internship on foundation models and multimodal systems.

publications.name: On the Perception Bottleneck of VLMs for Chart Understanding
